items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: Faz and I were good friends. I mean, really good friends.

ctx.x: Is this the third rail? Right.
Okay. We were talking about Fazila, Dave, and you said you played in several groups with him, the Hollywood.

Well yes, I was an organized band at the Hollywood, and of course he played with us on the staff of the Dawn Busters in a lot of parts of his life, but then I had played any number of jobs that let's say disorganized, somebody has a job at night and you play with them. So I knew Faz, let's say, practically all of my mature professional life.
